scoring_justification: Absolute formation energies and optical gaps are compared to paper-reported values with tolerances; structural ordering checks verify the main conclusion under O-rich conditions.

steps.description: Verifies that results.csv exists and has required columns
Verifies that optical_gap.csv exists and has required columns
Checks formation energies against Table 2 with tolerance 0.3 eV
Verifies O-rich stability ordering AGZO < AZO < GZO
Checks optical gaps against Table 3 with tolerance 0.1 eV
Verifies optical gap ordering AGZO > AZO > GZO

hidden_assets.purpose: Store paper-reported formation energies (Table 2) and optical gaps (Table 3) as hidden gold references.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Extracted from Table 2 and Table 3 of the accepted manuscript (DOI: 10.1016/j.ijleo.2018.10.135).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct transcription of the published numerical values for the specified systems and conditions.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The values are exact reproductions of the published experimental DFT results, ensuring the checker validates genuine computation of the paper's main results.

outputs.description: Formation energies of pure ZnO, Al-doped ZnO, Ga-doped ZnO, and Al/Ga co-doped ZnO under Zn-rich and O-rich conditions.
Optical band gaps of Al-doped ZnO, Ga-doped ZnO, and Al/Ga co-doped ZnO.

output_contract.notes: Formation energies and optical band gaps are compared to paper-reported values with tolerances. Ranking of formation energies under O-rich (AGZO < AZO < GZO) and optical gaps (AGZO > AZO > GZO) is also verified.
